svg.title: anysearch-cli: search, research, and memory for agents, behind a domain allowlist that actually holds
svg.desc: Pipeline: ans or ans-mcp fans a query out to tavily, exa and anysearch; a domain gate (urlAllowlist, pre and post filter) keeps allowed results, which are RRF-merged with source tags and stored in FTS5 memory with run traces. When nothing is left, it abstains with exit code 0.
